title: fix(plugin-auth): remove-sso-user writes an admin audit row; host-failure texts say the removal is refused
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Ca1jJvsA1dHsPwMiQb

Fixes #34404

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

1. 用户能看到什么变化：管理员在托管环境里删掉一位还没登录过的待加入人员后，审计日志里会多出一条“谁删了谁”的记录；云端联系不上时删除照旧被拒，服务端日志与开发文档也改成如实说“删除被拒绝”。
2. 为什么做：上一轮“删除待加入人员”功能评审遗留的两项问题，删除操作此前不留管理员审计记录，而日志与文档写着“删除照常进行”。
3. 出错会怎样：最坏是审计记录写不进去，删除本身仍然成功并在日志里报警；回退本改动即可恢复原状。
4. 要你做什么：无，席位落地。

## 席位核对

### What changes

- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/environment-user-host.ts`: the `goesAhead('removed')` log sentence said "The removal goes ahead." although `runRemoveSsoUser` answers `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` on `host_failed` (both the member-throw and the accessor-throw paths). It now says "The removal is refused: the door keeps no record to ask the host again from." The file header and the `EnvironmentUserHost` docblock now list a removal with a deactivation as refused on a host failure. The `added` / `deactivated` / `reactivated` sentences are unchanged (A1: only `removed` was false).
- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.ts`: the `environmentUserHost` option docblock, same correction.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/pending-sso-users.ts`: a removal that committed calls the shared `writeAdminAudit` with `action: 'delete'`, `recordId` the removed user, and `metadata` `{ event: 'user.admin_removed_pending', hostNotified }`. Every refusal path returns before it, so a refused removal writes nothing.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-user-endpoints.ts`: `writeAdminAudit`'s `action` admits `'delete'` (a declared `sys_audit_log.action` option), and `AdminAuditDecisions` gains the `user.admin_removed_pending` variant. Neither symbol is exported from the package entry.
- `.changeset/34404-remove-sso-user-audit-row.md`: `@objectstack/plugin-auth` patch.

The door's behaviour is unchanged apart from the new audit row.

### Tests

Head `19f393f361` (round 2, per L1-a ACCEPT 7004734980). The pins live in the component's shared harness, `pending-sso-users.test.ts`, as one top-level `describe('[#34404] admin/remove-sso-user writes an admin audit row for a removal that committed')` on its `stage()` / `managedStage()`. Each case adds the person through the real `admin/add-sso-user` route and removes them through the real `admin/remove-sso-user` route:
- A committed removal writes exactly one `delete` row, both with and without a host.
- CONTROLS: an unreachable host (`503`, the person is kept), a typed host refusal, and a not-pending person (`409`) write zero rows.

The round-1 file `remove-sso-user-audit-row-34404.test.ts` is deleted.

<details><summary>Readings</summary>

- Targeted run on `pending-sso-users.test.ts` + `pending-sso-seams.test.ts` + `admin-user-endpoints.test.ts`: Test Files 3 passed (3), Tests 219 passed (219); lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Ablation at `19f393f361`: the `writeAdminAudit` call guarded never to run (blob 13f9a76b → 844dc222) gives 2 failed / 2 passed. The two row pins go red and the two CONTROLs stay green. Restored: blob == HEAD.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck`: exit 0.

</details>

### Acceptance notes

- Item 3 of the card (the comment promised on #33187) is posted by the area as 7004259178, so this PR now says `Fixes`.
- Follow-up #35440 (p3, nested under #34404) covers two things: the route ledger note and the docs page, which don't mention the audit row yet; and `admin/ban-user` / `admin/unban-user`, which write no explicit admin audit row.

`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` at `19f393f361` gives 77 families: 76 exit 0, and 1 NOT MEASURED (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, which needs a full build; CI runs it). `overlap-check.mjs --branch=HEAD`: clean.
